content.learning_goal: Teach learners to understand and apply the main ideas of 'The Decision of the Panchayat'.

explanation_sections.title: Connect
explanation_sections.explanation: Begin with learners' prior experience related to The Decision of the Panchayat and invite predictions.

explanation_sections.title: Explore
explanation_sections.explanation: Use the chapter evidence below to build the explanation rather than introducing unsupported facts.
source_evidence: Let us Read 8 The Decision of the Panchayat Once upon a time, there lived a farmer in a small village.
Since the farmer needed a source of water for his fields, he bought the well from his neighbour.
He refused to let the farmer take water from the well.
On asking why, he replied, “I sold only the well to you, not the water.

explanation_sections.title: Make meaning
explanation_sections.explanation: Ask learners to explain what the evidence shows, compare ideas, and justify answers.

explanation_sections.title: Apply
explanation_sections.explanation: Move from a chapter example to a new, closely related example.

teaching_sequence.teacher_action: Model close reading/working with the chapter.

teaching_sequence.student_action: Explain why an answer is supported.

misconceptions: Giving an answer without explaining the reasoning.
checks_for_understanding: What evidence in 'The Decision of the Panchayat' supports your answer?
Can you explain the idea in your own words?
content.closure: Ask the learner to state the most important idea and one way it can be used.
